Source: `worldbank/pea`, branch `Package_updates-SEP-30th`, commit `4ec2b06ce63e99771630a8f1e1bb8447cbd6f744`. `VERIFIED_STATIC` The calls were checked against the declarations at this revision. `UNVERIFIED` No Stata execution or successful country-year output is established. Known limitations appear beside the relevant calls.

- `EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY` Use Stata 18 with PEA, its dependencies and the saved data listed in [setup](../stata_commands/012.md#s-a6831021766f70e1-l1) and each full record.
- `VERIFIED_STATIC` The PPP conversion shown assumes annual `welfare` and matching `cpi2021`/`icp2021`. Keep any correctly prepared variables already present and skip their `gen` lines. Supply your country's actual `natwelfare` and `natline`; the presence checks do not establish correct values. `source-ref-18e45afd459d1b95184f.do:L15-L36`.
- `VERIFIED_STATIC` `head`, `married` and `nowork` use raw GMD codes. `nowork` is 0 working, 1 not working, missing when unknown. [Input contracts](../stata_commands/004.md#s-8d6b513090f6244e-l7) explain the preparation.
- `EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY` Supply actual survey-comparability groups in `comparability` and observations for both years in each spell. Multiple pairs use a semicolon: `spells(0000 0000; 0000 0000)`. `Stata/plus/p/pea_figure3a.ado:L51-L719`; `source-ref-18e45afd459d1b95184f.do:L148-L148`.
- `VERIFIED_STATIC` `excel()` needs an existing workbook, so each block creates one in the current directory. Choose an unused filename and keep it identical in the preparation and call; `confirm new file` stops if it exists. `Stata/plus/_/_pea_export_path.ado:L20-L35`; `Stata/plus/p/pea_core.ado:L93-L99`.

These are starting points using the package example's variable names. Substitute your own variables, country, peers, years and filenames. Choose one entry and load a fresh copy of your survey; these are separate examples, not one do-file.

Source: `worldbank/pea`, branch `Package_updates-SEP-30th`, commit `4ec2b06ce63e99771630a8f1e1bb8447cbd6f744`. `VERIFIED_STATIC` The calls were checked against the declarations at this revision. `UNVERIFIED` No Stata execution or successful country-year output is established. Known limitations appear beside the relevant calls.

- `EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY` Use Stata 18 with PEA, its dependencies and the saved data listed in [setup](../stata_commands/012.md#s-a6831021766f70e1-l1) and each full record.
- `VERIFIED_STATIC` The PPP conversion shown assumes annual `welfare` and matching `cpi2021`/`icp2021`. Keep any correctly prepared variables already present and skip their `gen` lines. Supply your country's actual `natwelfare` and `natline`; the presence checks do not establish correct values. `source-ref-18e45afd459d1b95184f.do:L15-L36`.
- `VERIFIED_STATIC` `head`, `married` and `nowork` use raw GMD codes. `nowork` is 0 working, 1 not working, missing when unknown. [Input contracts](../stata_commands/004.md#s-8d6b513090f6244e-l7) explain the preparation.
- `EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY` Supply actual survey-comparability groups in `comparability` and observations for both years in each spell. Multiple pairs use a semicolon: `spells(0000 0000; 0000 0000)`. `Stata/plus/p/pea_figure3a.ado:L51-L719`; `source-ref-18e45afd459d1b95184f.do:L148-L148`.
- `VERIFIED_STATIC` `excel()` needs an existing workbook, so each block creates one in the current directory. Choose an unused filename and keep it identical in the preparation and call; `confirm new file` stops if it exists. `Stata/plus/_/_pea_export_path.ado:L20-L35`; `Stata/plus/p/pea_core.ado:L93-L99`.
